identitySignals: Company website names 'COLBI Technologies, Inc.' with its address in Tustin, CA, matching the agenda location 'Tustin, CA'

Company makes capital building program and construction management software for school districts and other public agencies, matching OUSD's 'Technology' contract presented by Facilities Planning and Management
OUSD funding source is Fund 21 Measure J, a school facilities bond; the company's products (Account-Ability) track capital bond program budgets and spending
research.notes: Registry IDs not looked up. Third-party directory listings give a different street number (12841 Newport Avenue); the company's own website shows 13891 Newport Avenue, Suite 150, which is used here. No page found that directly states COLBI works with OUSD; identity rests on name, city and line of business.

profile.summary: COLBI Technologies, Inc. develops software and offers consulting and training for public agencies that manage capital building programs, such as school districts. Its tools cover construction program budgets and spending, contractor prequalification, construction document control and electronic bid receipt.

sources.title: Planning and Management Software Tool - COLBI Technologies

review.notes: The company website confirms COLBI Technologies, Inc., 13891 Newport Avenue, Suite 150, Tustin CA, phone (714) 505-9544, and capital building program software (Account-Ability, COLBIDocs, QualityBidders, SecureBids) plus training and consulting. That matches the Tustin, CA agenda location and a Facilities Planning technology contract funded by Measure J. The page does not mention OUSD, so identity rests on the name, city and line of business, which is a strong fit.
